summary: Reduce a reproducible web bottleneck through repeated baselines, causal isolation, one bounded change, and functional, visual, and variance checks.
triggers: A web flow has a reproducible performance regression or bottleneck.
Before-and-after traces must be compared against a declared budget.
A performance change needs functional, visual, accessibility, and field-evidence boundaries.
antiTriggers: Claim field improvement from one synthetic run.
Change production delivery without the task's release scope.
Improve a score by hiding content, errors, or accessibility defects.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Baseline, bottleneck isolation, bounded-change, variance, functional, visual, and field-proof semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no performance or deployment result is asserted.
